subject: computer-science
title: System Integration and Migration
welcome_lead: Plug systems together and move data safely during migrations.
meta_desc: CS adventure on system integration, migration strategies and compatibility.
final_note: Test, backup and pilot before big-bang migrations!

concepts.def: Combining separate systems into one solution.
Moving data or systems to new platforms.
Old and new run together during change.
Switch from old to new in one cutover.
Copy of data preserved against loss.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Front-end calls a REST API on back-end.

JSON returns are parsed and displayed; loose coupling enables independent updates.

Direct changeover is risky but cheap.

Parallel running is safer but doubles workload temporarily.

Audit source, map fields to new schema, test with sample, run pilot.

Verify checksums, take backups, then cutover.
